# Kaeduas

> Kaeduas is the AI entertainment studio of Qophe Junior Motsamai (QJ), a South African creative AI architect born in Bloemfontein, Free State on 4 June 2005. The studio makes generative video and AI advertising for Meta, YouTube and TikTok, plus brand design and web & AI systems, working with clients worldwide, remote-first.

## Key facts
- Founder: Qophe Junior Motsamai ("QJ Motsamai"), born 4 June 2005, Bloemfontein, South Africa — creative AI architect and entrepreneur
- Studio: Kaeduas, AI entertainment studio, founded June 2026, Bloemfontein, South Africa
- Services: generative video, AI advertising, brand & design, web & AI systems
- Booking: WhatsApp +27 67 236 3235 (fastest) or motsamai.main@gmail.com
- Notable work: Chicken Licken Meta ad, Galxboy All Black and Pink Slides ads, cinematic sunscreen ad, Luxe Homme × Kabza De Small duffel bag collab film
- Software: qj-research-agent (AI research agent, TypeScript/Gemini), mr-rage-bait (3D Gemini chatbot, Three.js)
